brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has called for killing "30 to 40" Palestinians in Gaza each night, Al Jazeera English reported. Ben-Gvir, who leads the far-right National Security Ministry, sits on Israel's security cabinet, the top-level body that shapes the country's war strategy and broader policy decisions affecting the conflict.

The statement reflects the hardline positions held by some members of Israel's security establishment as military operations in Gaza continue. Ben-Gvir's role on the security cabinet means his views directly influence discussions over military tactics and strategic direction in the enclave.
dek: Far-right National Security Minister Ben-Gvir sits on Israel's security cabinet, which helps shape war and policy.
title: Ben-Gvir calls for killing dozens of Palestinians nightly in Gaza.
